title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1969-11-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
lineage: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard tape with noticeable hiss but captures a high‑energy 1969 set featuring smoking Alligator and Uncle John’s jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard capture that suffers from tape hiss and a bit of muddiness, yet it remains listenable for a vintage 1969 performance. The show itself is praised for its fiery jams – especially the Alligator jam with Jerry’s solo, Uncle John's Jam, and a raucous Pigpen‑heavy second set – delivering an overall high‑energy experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.5 stars; comments overwhelmingly highlight standout jams and strong performance while noting only moderate tape hiss, resulting in a high overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Prominent tape hiss (“royal hiss”), occasional mud‑dyness, a brief cut in "Turn On Your Lovelight"; otherwise typical of 1969 board recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Jam‑heavy second set dominated by Pigpen and extended improvisations, with strong transitions between jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Soloed over percussion during the Alligator jam; tone praised implicitly.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) mentioned as playing keyboards on this show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Ludwig drums and strong percussive jams noted.
